source_interpretation.title: Three related cores share a two-stage shelling route
source_interpretation.text: CIS, CIGS and ZCIS differ in explicitly stated core-cation feed. OTT supplies sulfur and passivates the surface; two separately prepared zinc feeds grow ZnS shells for one hour each at240°C. Feed ratios do not measure final core stoichiometry.

source_interpretation.title: Only one oxide composition has absolute salt charges
source_interpretation.text: The Zn0.95Mg0.05O example uses2.85mmol Zn acetate dihydrate and0.15mmol Mg acetate tetrahydrate in30mL DMSO. The x=0 and0.1 variants adjust molar proportions with other parameters fixed. Their salt charges and the concentration/form of5mL TMAH remain unknown.

source_interpretation.title: Size evidence remains specimen-specific
source_interpretation.text: TEM mean3.2nm is assigned to CIGS/ZnS only. ZnO andZn0.9Mg0.1O have4.2nm and3.1nm means respectively; the x=0.05 size is not given. Similar-size wording and additional ZCIS images do not establish missing numeric means.

source_interpretation.title: Dispersion and film energy levels are different measurements
source_interpretation.text: Optical bandgaps of ZnMgO dispersions are3.73,3.89,4.07eV, while solid-film TableS1 gives3.66,3.82,3.93eV. UPS tabulates positive binding energies below vacuum; the QD PESA diagram uses signed negative vacuum-referenced energies. These conventions and specimen states are preserved.
source_interpretation.source_locator: Main pp.3–4; SI TableS1 and FigureS3

source_interpretation.title: Nine devices do not represent nine additional nanoparticle batches
source_interpretation.text: Three QD EMLs combine with three ZnMgO ETLs. The common fabrication method and exact maxima remain source-specific. Figure4b cross-section depicts only CIS/ZnS withZn0.95Mg0.05O; no other device borrows that image as its measured specimen.

source_interpretation.title: Efficiency interpretation is qualified
source_interpretation.text: Raising the oxide conduction band with Mg is proposed to improve electron injection. CIS device efficiency peaks atx=0.05, while CIGS and ZCIS efficiency increases throughx=0.1. Excess electron injection is a proposed explanation for the CIS efficiency decrease, not an independently established causal measurement.

table_s1.scope: Solid-film measurements and derived energies, distinct from dispersion gaps. Fermi/valence/conduction entries preserve positive source binding-energy convention; no sign reversal.

energy_analysis.scope: Source equations/interpretation; no reconstructed numerical curve data or measured atomic geometry.

figure4b_cross_section.scope: Only representative CIS/ZnS +Zn0.95Mg0.05O stack; geometry not transferred as measured evidence to other device combinations.

source_conflicts: Figure 2 caption repeats panel (d) for the Zn0.9Mg0.1O TEM image; the visible right-hand image is panel (e). The panel and specimen mapping retains this printed discrepancy.
The main methods print 1-octadecence (ODE); the conventional 1-octadecene reference is explicitly a reagent-identity interpretation of that spelling, not a new source purity claim.
ZnMgO dispersion bandgaps differ from the solid-film bandgaps in SI Table S1. Both sets remain separately scoped; neither silently replaces the other.
limitations: Complete supplied eight-page main and identity-matched six-page SI read; cited full texts unreviewed. Independent scientific comparison passed; presentation pending.
QD core feed ratios do not establish measured final alloy stoichiometry. CIS and ZCIS particle mean diameters are not supplied; the 3.2 nm TEM mean belongs only to CIGS.
ZnMgO absolute salt charges are reported only for x=0.05. The x=0 and x=0.1 molar-ratio variants share other conditions but no calculated absolute salt charges are substituted.
The 5 mL TMAH reagent has no concentration or hydration/solution-form specification. Moles, density, concentration and molecular solution structure remain unknown.

Heating rates, addition rates beyond rapid/slow, mixing speed, initial degassing time, workup volumes and purification-cycle count are unreported. Qualitative room temperature is not replaced with a number.
TEM means 4.2 nm and 3.1 nm belong to ZnO and Zn0.9Mg0.1O respectively. The x=0.05 mean remains unknown. No lattice parameters, atom coordinates or measured CIF are supplied.
Nine QLED combinations use already synthesized particles and are supporting fabrication/property procedures, not nine new nanoparticle syntheses. Exact physical batch identifiers are not provided.

UPS and PESA use characterization films distinct from dispersions and from the device films. Energy values retain their vacuum-reference sign convention; no exact device-film specimen identity is inferred.
Source figures retain owner-directed display status with publisher permission unverified. Stage geometry and molecular references are illustrative; complete presentation is pending.
